j=Path('/job');(j/'home').mkdir(exist_ok=True);(j/'pip-cache').mkdir(exist_ok=True)

 with (j/out).open('wb') as f:q=subprocess.run(args,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 if q.returncode:raise SystemExit(q.returncode)
run([sys.executable,'-VV'],'runtime-version.txt')
run([sys.executable,'-m','venv','/job/venv'],'venv-create.txt')
py='/job/venv/bin/python'
run([py,'-m','pip','--disable-pip-version-check','--no-input','download','--index-url','https://pypi.org/simple','--only-binary=:all:','--dest','/job/wheels','-r','requirements-test.txt'],'pip-download.txt')
run([py,'-m','pip','--disable-pip-version-check','--no-input','install','--no-index','--find-links','/job/wheels','--only-binary=:all:','--no-compile','-r','requirements-test.txt'],'pip-install.txt')
run([py,'-m','pip','freeze','--all'],'pip-freeze.txt')
run([py,'-m','pip','check'],'pip-check.txt')
rows=[{'name':p.name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'SHA256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted((j/'wheels').iterdir()) if p.is_file()]
(j/'wheel-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
